API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIForwarding Control PolicyZPA Gateway Resource Get ZPA Gateways
ZPA Gateway Resource Get ZPA Gateways
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/zpaGateways

Gets the list of Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) gateways configured in the ZIA Admin Portal. To learn about ZPA gateways, see About Zscaler Private Access Gateway.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to match against a ZPA gateway name or an associated Server Group name

appSegment
string[]

Filters the list by Application Segment

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

A unique identifier assigned to the ZPA gateway

name
string

The name of the ZPA gateway

zpaServerGroup
object
zpaAppSegments
object[]
zpaTenantId
int64

The ID of the ZPA tenant where Source IP Anchoring is configured

lastModifiedBy
object
lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the ZPA gateway was last modified

type
string

Indicates whether the ZPA gateway is configured for Zscaler Internet Access (using option ZPA) or Zscaler Cloud Connector (using option ECZPA)

Possible values: [ZPA, ECZPA]

description
string

Additional details about the ZPA gateway

]
